generalisation_beyond_the_registry.reading: 1 of 5 unseen walls closed. That is the honest transfer rate of this engine, and it is the number to quote. The registry's 11/11 is a set the author selected; the unseen rate is what a user would experience.

protocol: single-parent commits from three external repositories; ONLY the fix commit's test files are copied onto a /dev/shm worktree of the parent; no source diff, patch, commit message, or issue text is read by the engine; a repair counts only when the copied tests pass AND the project's own suite fails no more than it did on the untouched parent

rows.wall: an undocumented argument must still get a help row
empty envvar == absent envvar, and a sequence envvar names every member
a second interrupt while reporting must not replace the decided outcome
help option names must keep declaration order: `set()` is used where the returned list order is part of the contract
wrapping must not break hyphenated words: the repo states this policy in `utils.py` and omits it at the `TextWrapper` construction in `formatting.py`
a public method the test wraps in `pytest.deprecated_call()` must emit a DeprecationWarning, which it currently does not
an empty parameter payload must not leave a trailing separator
a suffix cardinality of zero selects nothing and must be refused
a documented default that is only reachable behind a feature flag
two co-required contracts inside one test: arity and state
the recorded distribution must be dropped with the plugin

the_mechanism.form_from: the repository's own idiom: warnings.warn(..., DeprecationWarning, stacklevel=2)
the_mechanism.name: DEMANDED_DEPRECATION_EMISSION
the_mechanism.refusal_reading: Both refusals are correct. e43d440c needs a property plus an __init__ change, and 3d27209c needs IRI encoding on the location setter. Neither is a bare deprecation demand, so no candidate fires. A mechanism that fired on everything would be worth less than one that fires on its shape and stops.
the_mechanism.requirement_from: the fix commit's test: `with pytest.deprecated_call(): response.freeze()`

what_changed_since_v2.why_it_matters: This wall was NOT in the registry when the receipt said 10/10. It was found by scanning unseen werkzeug commits for evidence shapes, and it closed on the first evaluation. It is the first wall in this file that was chosen by a scan rather than by the author's judgement, which is the only sense in which the registry number has begun to mean something beyond itself.
